Market insight built around your brand.

Bespoke trend and market direction developed specifically for your brand, customer and positioning. We identify what is emerging, what is commercially relevant and, importantly, what is right for you.

From colour, fabric and silhouette to product, graphics, styling and cultural shifts, we translate global movements into a focused point of view for your market.

Whether you need direction for a new season, validation of an existing idea or a clearer understanding of where your customer is heading, we turn research into actionable creative direction — helping you decide what to develop, what to ignore and where the opportunity lies.

Not trends for everyone. Direction relevant to your brand.
